result.summary: This is a narrow urban residential street with sidewalks on both sides but no marked pedestrian crossings or traffic calming measures. High density of on-street parking on both sides creates significant visual obstructions for pedestrians attempting to cross the roadway.

hazards.description: Continuous on-street parking on both sides of the street blocks sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the foreground and midground

hazards.description: There are no designated or marked places for pedestrians to cross the street safely.

result.summary: The image shows a dense residential mid-block environment with a continuous, paved sidewalk directly adjacent to on-street parallel parking. There is no physical buffer or street furniture separating pedestrians from the roadway, and large parked vehicles create significant visual obstructions between the walkway and the street.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Large vehicles, such as the white van in the foreground, block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian-vehicle separation
hazards.description: The sidewalk is immediately adjacent to the parking lane with no buffer zone or street furniture to protect pedestrians from vehicle doors or movement.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planters
interventions.description: Installing street trees or a planting strip would provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implementing curb extensions at the nearest intersections would improve visibility and shorten crossing distances for this residential block.

result.summary: The image shows a narrow residential street lined with row houses and parallel-parked vehicles. While the narrow roadway likely encourages lower vehicle speeds, the lack of a buffer between the narrow sidewalk and the travel lane, combined with visual obstructions from parked cars, limits pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on both sides of the narrow street block sight lines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and midground, both sides of the street

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The narrow sidewalk is immediately adjacent to the parking lane with no physical buffer or planting strip to separate pedestrians from vehicle activity.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the sidewalk edge in front of the houses
